user.title: Connect ATLAS Runtime
user.description: Enter the browser-accessible base URL of your existing ATLAS runtime, including any reverse-proxy prefix. ATLAS must already run as an App/Add-on, Docker container or Linux service. Tokens and plugins stay in ATLAS Administration. Use HTTPS when Home Assistant uses HTTPS.

error.invalid_runtime_url: Use an HTTP/HTTPS base URL without credentials, query parameters or fragment.

init.title: ATLAS Runtime address
init.description: Changing the address opens a different browser storage context. Keep the previous ATLAS address to preserve local projects and encrypted settings. Export them in ATLAS before deliberately moving to another address.

error.invalid_runtime_url: Use an HTTP/HTTPS base URL without credentials, query parameters or fragment.
